metric: Paired D14 minus D0 change in total slips across three retained crossings per day
layout: Circles: mice; diamonds: cohort-specific cage means; bars: equally weighted mouse means. Standard Illustrator palette and dimensions.
exclusion: Require three retained crossings for each included day; change excludes TMCS2_S10 with only two D0 crossings. D14 includes that mouse.
slipOverlapPolicy: Slips during stops included, matching existing D0 count panel
